scope: DMR1 variant 2 as revised 2026-11-28: depth_loop_kept and depth_loop_merged, seed 20260726 each, one session per arm; the first runs the engine validation before training
per_session_rule: each session's own cap is its arm's (kinds.dmr1_loop_train.per_arm); this field is the larger, which no single session may exceed; the ceiling is both sessions'
hardware: one NVIDIA L40S, secure cloud, at most $1.11/h, 150 GB container disk, no network volume

balance.rule: checked at each issue and launch against that session's cap plus the reserve

basis.step_time: SOB1's measured 4.83 s / step (V1 measured 4.87) and the 7.241 s bound, x 1.80 (teacher 36 + 4 x 36 student logical-layer forward-equivalents vs 36 + 4 x 16): NOT measured -- the first four steps measure it
basis.evaluation: SOB1's 1.22 h expected / 3.0 h bound per unit, x 2.25 (36 / 16 logical layers of decode work and KV cache)
basis.not_the_same_compute: same data and optimizer steps as the single-execution controls, about 1.8x the training work per token and 2.25x the decode work: reported as measured GPU time, never as matched compute

memory_gib.rule: SOB1's measured depth peak plus the added tensors (not measured)
memory_gib.risk: the loop arms' estimated reserved peak leaves about 1.9 GiB of the L40S: real. The first four steps' memory_probe measures it; an out-of-memory error is answered first by the recipe's protocol-neutral steps (expandable segments, kd_chunk), then -- only after a measured OOM and under a decision of its own -- an 80 GB card

money_rules.own_envelope: its own grant; variant 1's grants (dmr1_merge_build, dmr1_merge_train) are not carried over and fund nothing here; SOB1's closed grants' remainders are void
money_rules.cumulative: the two sessions share the kind's envelope; a retry's cap is what the envelope leaves after every earlier attempt's closeout, minus the reserve
money_rules.teardown_reserve: $1.00 per session, held outside the ceiling, never issued

authorizes: nothing: a proposal; the grant is the maintainer's
